name: Echo Trails
description: 👻 Race against your ghost! Records your best run and displays a phantom replay of yourself to compete against. Features smooth interpolation, time difference indicator, and customizable visuals.

enabled.name: ✨ Enable Echo Trails
enabled.description: Master toggle for ghost recording and playback.

record-fps.name: 📹 Recording FPS
record-fps.description: Frames per second for ghost recording. Higher = smoother playback, larger files.

ghost-color.name: 🎨 Ghost Color
ghost-color.description: Color of the ghost sprite. Options: blue, red, green, purple, yellow, cyan, white

show-time-diff.name: ⏱️ Show Time Difference
show-time-diff.description: Display position difference indicator above ghost.

glow-effect.name: ✨ Glow Effect
glow-effect.description: Add glowing aura around the ghost for better visibility.
